title: GTA 6's Car Physics Tuned by Gran Turismo Pro
description: Rockstar Games has reportedly hired a former Gran Turismo pro to help master the car handling and physics in GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## From GT to GTA: Former Racing Pro Joins Rockstar's Physics Team

When it comes to open-world action games, the driving mechanics can make or break the immersion. For years, fans of Rockstar Games' legendary franchise have debated the arcade-like versus simulation styles of vehicle handling in the series. Now, new details from gaming media outlet Push Square shed light on how the studio is tackling the vehicle physics for the highly anticipated *GTA 6*.

According to the reports, Rockstar Games brought in a former *Gran Turismo* professional esports driver to assist in mastering the car handling for *GTA 6*.

### Three and a Half Years of Dedicated Tuning

The person behind this crucial tuning work is Lewis Bentley, a 2018 GT World Series Finalist who brings a deep understanding of professional racing simulation to the table.

Reports indicate that Bentley has spent the last three-and-a-half years working directly with the studio's physics team. His core focus during this extended period has been dedicated to refining how the cars feel to drive in the game. This unique collaboration highlights Rockstar's meticulous approach to blending authentic racing expertise with the expansive sandbox environment of the *GTA* universe.

### What This Means for the Driving Experience

While previous titles favored an accessible handling model that balanced chaos and control, the involvement of a seasoned simulation racer suggests that *GTA 6* could offer a more nuanced and satisfying driving model. Whether players are engaging in high-speed police chases or cruising down the highways, the upgraded physics engine—backed by professional esports experience—aims to elevate the overall vehicular gameplay. We will have to wait for official gameplay deep-dives to see how these physics translate to the controller.

## Editor's Take

Hiring a top-tier racing pro like Lewis Bentley shows Rockstar's commitment to polishing every single pillar of *GTA 6*. Vehicle handling is core to the open-world experience, and injecting real-world GT expertise into the physics engine could give the driving mechanics an unprecedented level of depth and responsiveness.
